name: Volute
author: Erin Carter
description: A glowing tube wound into a spiral that fills the frame, charge spinning outward along the coil while the hue turns with each revolution. One arm or several over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Coil pitch
params.effect: Radial distance between coils in CSS pixels - a tight dense whorl at the minimum, a few broad sweeps at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of the glowing coil in CSS pixels, from a hairline thread to a fat neon tube.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge spinning outward along the coil; 0 freezes it, high sets the whole spiral whirling.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around the coil; low is a crisp drawn line, high a luminous bloom filling the gaps.

params.label: Arms
params.effect: Number of interleaved spiral arms, from a single winding coil to a multi-armed pinwheel.

params.label: Hue twist
params.effect: How fast the hue turns as the coil winds outward; 0 is a near-single-colour spiral, high bands it into a tight rainbow whorl.

params.label: Bead fill
params.effect: Fraction of cells along the coil that light as a soft glowing bead riding the tube; 0 leaves a clean line, high strings it with LEDs.

params.label: Bead size
params.effect: Size of each lit bead within its cell, from a small point to a fat blob that nearly fills the gap between windings.

params.label: Twinkle
params.effect: Makes the beads breathe in and out, each on its own random phase, so the coil shimmers.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls which cells light and their twinkle phases for a fresh arrangement of beads on the same coil.

params.label: Centre X
params.effect: Slides the vortex eye left or right, in short-axis units, so the spiral winds out from an off-centre point.

params.label: Centre Y
params.effect: Slides the vortex eye up or down, in short-axis units, so the spiral winds out from an off-centre point.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole spiral about its eye, in degrees.

params.label: Tilt
params.effect: Rocks the coil fore and back in a perspective-ish tilt, so it reads as a vortex tunnel lying away from or toward the viewer.

params.label: Skew
params.effect: Leans the coil left or right, shearing the spiral off its upright axis for an angled, in-space read.
